rights.rightsReviewer: Codex source-page review; per-file license and VRT notice inspected before download
rights.licenseEvidenceSummary: Per-file notice grants sharing and adaptation under CC BY-SA 3.0; commercial reuse permitted subject to attribution, license link, change notice and ShareAlike. The listed VRT ticket confirms the public permission notice; private ticket contents were not accessed.

derivativeLicense.changeNotice: Cliniverse local review derivative: VP8 to H.264, one black pixel added at right edge, source container metadata removed. No crop, mask, interpolation or frame-rate conversion.
derivativeLicense.distributionStatus: local-review-only; attribution and license must accompany any future authorized distribution

screening.reviewer: Codex technical and visual screening, not specialist approval
screening.privacy: No direct identifiers or acquisition dates/times observed. Retained source credits, depth/grayscale scales, ECG and HR with changing timing/phase annotation. Final privacy/provenance review pending.
screening.motion: All 44 presentation timestamps identical; no frames added or dropped. Ordered frames show continuous progression without new discontinuity. Source-native rate and loop sufficiency remain specialist-review questions. Last sample/container duration is 1 ms shorter (863 to 862 ms); no presentation timestamp changed.

imageComparison.method: FFmpeg SSIM across 44 decoded frames against right-padded original
imageComparison.interpretation: Engineering similarity only; not clinical validation. Lossy CRF16 encode; dark apical/endocardial source detail remains limited.

screening.anatomy: Full source rectangle preserved; four-chamber geometry retained. No crop or overlay removal.

mobile.assessment: Cavity geometry visible; fine apical detail and small overlays limited.

ipad.assessment: Geometry and source context retained; enlargement adds no detail.

desktop.assessment: Geometry retained; dark endocardial detail remains limited.

binaryLocationPolicy: Outside repository; not installed in public media, runtime manifests or Studio. Contact sheets/frames and logs also excluded.
